text:
ITEM 1 | Orange-fleshed cut pieces with smooth, slightly glossy skin-free surfaces, sliced into thick rounds and diagonal coins about 0.5-1 cm thick and 3-5 cm long, some with a glazed, slightly caramelized sheen and darker edges, piled in a loose cluster on the lower-left of the plate | 110

ITEM 2 | Pale orange, firm cubed and wedged pieces with a matte, slightly fibrous surface, cut into chunky triangular wedges and cubes about 2-3 cm per side, arranged in an arc across the upper-right of the plate, moist-looking but holding their shape | 120

ITEM 3 | Whole round fruit with smooth, glossy red-to-yellow blushed skin and a slight sheen, about 7-8 cm in diameter, sitting on the left edge of the plate, firm and intact | 170

ITEM 4 | Cooked white rice, long-grain, separate loose grains with a soft, slightly moist surface and no sauce, mounded in a fan-shaped pile about 12 cm long and 5-6 cm wide, roughly 2 cm high, on the lower-right of the plate | 150
